# semaphore_ex_global_role_assignment (Resource)

Assigns a global custom role to a user.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "semaphore_ex_global_role_assignment" "auditor" {
  user_id = semaphore_ex_user.example.id
  role_id = semaphore_ex_global_role.auditor.id
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `role_id` (String) Opaque global role ID.
- `user_id` (Number) Assigned user ID.

### Read-Only

- `id` (Number) Server-generated assignment ID.
- `revision` (Number) Server revision required for deletion.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# Replace illustrative identifiers with the existing object identity.
terraform import semaphore_ex_global_role_assignment.auditor user/1/assignment/2
```
